hero.name: Sahashra Janith
hero.title: Full-Stack Web Developer & Software Engineer
hero.subtitle: Full-Stack Web Developer & Software Engineer. I craft high-performance web systems, LMS portals, e-commerce stores, Android mobile applications, and modern web experiences.
hero.about_text_1: I am a passionate Full-Stack Web Developer & Software Engineer based in Sri Lanka. I hold an NVQ Level 4 in Software Development and a Diploma in Information & Communication Technology (ICT) from the National Vocational Training Institute (NVTI).
hero.about_text_2: My technical journey is centered on engineering high-performance online systems — including LMS portals, examination platforms, AL tuition management apps, e-commerce stores, and modern responsive web experiences.

projects.title: Zenith Academy LMS & Exam Portal
projects.desc: Comprehensive educational academy platform featuring online exam management, student portals, and digital course resources.
projects.longDesc: Zenith Academy is a full-featured Learning Management & Online Examination System built to streamline tuition operations. Features timed online quizzes, student progress dashboards, automated grade calculation, and secure resource downloads.

projects.title: ScholarPro Academic Evaluation Portal
projects.desc: Advanced web platform designed for academic testing, online exams, student performance tracking, and resource distribution.
projects.longDesc: ScholarPro empowers educational institutions with an online testing environment. Provides instant result generation, detailed subject-wise analytical reports, and interactive study modules.

projects.title: Chaminda sumanathilaka Science Learning Portal
projects.desc: Dedicated online science education website featuring digital lessons, interactive quiz modules, and study materials.
projects.longDesc: A specialized web portal tailored for science students. Includes categorized subject modules, interactive lesson quizzes, downloadable revision papers, and direct student inquiry channels.

projects.title: Bloomy Haven E-Commerce Store
projects.desc: Full-featured online store with product catalogs, shopping cart engine, responsive product showcase, and checkout system.
projects.longDesc: Bloomy Haven is an e-commerce platform built for online shopping. Delivers fluid product filtering, dynamic cart drawer management, category browsing, and order confirmation workflows.

projects.title: SAKWA CANNERIES & EXPORTS Inventory System
projects.desc: Official web domain platform hosting live web applications, digital client services, and modern software solutions.

projects.title: AL Class Management System
projects.desc: Student and class management web portal built for A/L tuition institutes to handle enrollments, fees, and attendance.
projects.longDesc: Hosted online tuition class management system designed for managing student profiles, class schedules, fee payments, and attendance records efficiently.

projects.title: Microfinance  Android Mobile App
projects.longDesc: Native Android mobile application built with Java enabling students and tuition administrators to access class schedules, receive real-time notifications, and track course updates on mobile devices.

projects.title: Pos  Sri lanka

projects.longDesc: Keep billing non-stop during power cuts and internet downtime. Manage Barcode inventory, Customer Credit (ණය පොත), and Daily Profit from any Android phone, tab, or POS machine.
